addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

[2025/10] 新增[experimental](experimental)目录，完善[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)，支持开发者调试并贡献自定义算子。 23 - [2025/09] ops-transformer项目首次上线，开源算子支持Atlas A2/A3系列产品。 24 25 ## 🚀概述 26 27 ops-transformer是[CANN](https://hiascend.com/software/cann)（Compute Architecture for Neural Networks）算子库中提供transformer类大模型计算的进阶算子库，包括attention类、moe类、mc2类等，覆盖各类attention、MoE计算、通算融合等场景，算子库在架构图中的位置如下。 28 29 30 31 ## 📌版本配套 32 33 本项目源码会跟随CANN软件版本发布，关于CANN软件版本与本项目标签的对应关系请参阅[release仓库](https://gitcode.com/cann/release-management)中的相应版本说明。 34 请注意，为确保您的源码定制开发顺利进行，请选择配套的CANN版本与Gitcode标签源码，使用master分支可能存在版本不匹配的风险。 35 36 ## 🛠️环境准备 37 38 [环境部署](docs/zh/install/quick_install.md)是体验本项目能力的前提，请先完成NPU驱动、CANN包安装等，确保环境正常。 39 40 ## ⬇️源码下载 41 42 环境准备好后，下载与CANN版本配套的分支源码，通用命令如下，\$\{tag\_version\}替换为分支标签名。以9.0.0分支源码下载为例： 43 44 ```bash 45 # 通用命令：git clone -b ${tag_version} https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer.git 46 git clone -b 9.0.0 https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer.git 47 ``` 48 49 > 说明：若环境中已存在配套分支源码，**可跳过本步骤**，例如CANNLab默认已提供最新版本CANN对应的源码。 50 51 ## 📖学习教程 52 53 - [快速入门](docs/QUICKSTART.md)：从零开始快速体验项目核心基础能力，涵盖源码编译、算子调用、开发与调试等操作。 54 - [进阶教程](docs/README.md)：如需深入了解项目编译部署、算子调用、开发、调试调优等能力，请查阅文档中心获取详细指引。 55 56 ## 💬相关信息 57 58 - [目录结构](docs/zh/install/dir_structure.md) 59 - file.content: # ops-transformer ## 🔥Latest News - [2026/07] A5上新支持算子[quant_flash_attn](attention/quant_flash_attn)，Dense Attention全量化场景专用，以及experimental目录新增[同名算子](experimental/attention/quant_flash_attn)支持A5的MxFP4全量化；[chunk_gated_delta_rule](attention/chunk_gated_delta_rule)算子支持A5；A5新增DSV4 dense训练阶段TopK筛选反向算子[dense_lightning_indexer_grad_kl_loss](attention/dense_lightning_indexer_grad_kl_loss)、[dense_lightning_indexer_softmax_lse](attention/dense_lightning_indexer_softmax_lse)；mc2新支持算子[engram_fetch_grad](mc2/engram_fetch_grad)。 - [2026/06] A5上新增支持[sparse_flash_mla](attention/sparse_flash_mla)、[mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla](attention/mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla)以及对应的metadata算子，用于DSV4场景稀疏Attention计算。新增[lightning_indexer_v2](attention/lightning_indexer_v2)、[quant_lightning_indexer_v2](attention/quant_lightning_indexer_v2)以及对应的metadata算子，用于DSV4场景TopK筛选。A5新增DSV4 sparse训练阶段Attention反向算子[sparse_flash_mla_grad](attention/sparse_flash_mla_grad)、[sparse_lightning_indexer_kl_loss_grad](attention/sparse_lightning_indexer_kl_loss_grad)；mc2新支持算子[engram_fetch](mc2/engram_fetch)、[engram_fetch_wait](mc2/engram_fetch_wait)。 - [2026/05] [fused_infer_attention_score](attention/fused_infer_attention_score)算子A5上支持MxFP8全量化；A5上新支持算子[flash_attn](attention/flash_attn)，Dense Attention非量化场景专用。 - [2026/04] mc2新支持算子[mega_moe](mc2/mega_moe)。 - [2026/03] [recurrent_gated_delta_rule](attention/recurrent_gated_delta_rule)算子支持A5。 - [2026/02] 新支持算子[mhc_post](experimental/mhc/mhc_post)、[mhc_pre](experimental/mhc/mhc_pre)、[mhc_res](experimental/mhc/mhc_res)。 - [2026/01] 新支持算子[grouped_matmul<<<>>>调用示例](examples/fast_kernel_launch_example/csrc/grouped_matmul)，方便用户自定义使用。 - [2026/01] 新支持算子[fused_floyd_attention](attention/fused_floyd_attention)、[fused_floyd_attention_grad](attention/fused_floyd_attention_grad)、[matmul_allto_all](mc2/matmul_allto_all)。 - [2025/12] 新增[QuickStart](docs/QUICKSTART.md)，指导新手零基础入门算子项目部署（支持Docker环境）、算子开发和贡献流程。 - [2025/12] 优化指南类文档，聚焦[算子开发指南](docs/zh/develop/aicore_develop_guide.md)，明确最小交付件和关键示例代码，针对[Ascend/samples](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/tree/master)仓算子提供迁移本项目的指导。 - [2025/12] 支持transformer类onnx算子插件，包括[NPUFlashAttention](attention/flash_attention_score/framework)、[NPUMultiHeadAttention](common/src/framework)、[NPUMoeComputeExpertTokens](moe/moe_compute_expert_tokens/framework)等。 - [2025/12] 新支持算子[kv_rms_norm_rope_cache](posembedding/kv_rms_norm_rope_cache)、[attention_update](attention/attention_update)、[attention_worker_scheduler](attention/attention_worker_scheduler)、[gather_pa_kv_cache](attention/gather_pa_kv_cache)、[kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention](attention/kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention)、[lightning_indexer_grad](attention/lightning_indexer_grad)、[mla_preprocess](attention/mla_preprocess)、[mla_preprocess_v2](attention/mla_preprocess_v2)、[grouped_matmul_swiglu_quant_v2](gmm/grouped_matmul_swiglu_quant_v2)、[attention_to_ffn](mc2/attention_to_ffn)、[ffn_to_attention](mc2/ffn_to_attention)。 - [2025/12] 开源算子支持[NPU Simulator](docs/zh/debug/npu_sim.md)仿真工具开发调试。 - [2025/12] 开源算子支持[Ascend 950PR/Ascend 950DT](docs/zh/ascend950_op_list.md)/KirinX90系列产品。 - [2025/11] 新支持算子[kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention](attention/kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention)、[lightning_indexer](attention/lightning_indexer)、[quant_lightning_indexer](attention/quant_lightning_indexer)、[sparse_flash_attention](attention/sparse_flash_attention)。 - [2025/11] 新支持示例算子[rope_matrix](experimental/posembedding/rope_matrix)和[all_gather_add](examples/mc2/all_gather_add)。 - [2025/11] 新增算子开发工程模板[NpuOpsTransformerExt](experimental/npu_ops_transformer_ext)，无缝集成PyTorch张量操作，支持自动微分和GPU/NPU统一接口。 - [2025/10] 新增[experimental](experimental)目录，完善[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)，支持开发者调试并贡献自定义算子。 - [2025/09] ops-transformer项目首次上线，开源算子支持Atlas A2/A3系列产品。 ## 🚀概述 ops-transformer是[CANN](https://hiascend.com/software/cann)（Compute Architecture for Neural Networks）算子库中提供transformer类大模型计算的进阶算子库，包括attention类、moe类、mc2类等，覆盖各类attention、MoE计算、通算融合等场景，算子库在架构图中的位置如下。 ## 📌版本配套 本项目源码会跟随CANN软件版本发布，关于CANN软件版本与本项目标签的对应关系请参阅[release仓库](https://gitcode.com/cann/release-management)中的相应版本说明。 请注意，为确保您的源码定制开发顺利进行，请选择配套的CANN版本与Gitcode标签源码，使用master分支可能存在版本不匹配的风险。 ## 🛠️环境准备 [环境部署](docs/zh/install/quick_install.md)是体验本项目能力的前提，请先完成NPU驱动、CANN包安装等，确保环境正常。 ## ⬇️源码下载 环境准备好后，下载与CANN版本配套的分支源码，通用命令如下，\$\{tag\_version\}替换为分支标签名。以9.0.0分支源码下载为例： ```bash # 通用命令：git clone -b ${tag_version} https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer.git git clone -b 9.0.0 https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer.git ``` > 说明：若环境中已存在配套分支源码，**可跳过本步骤**，例如CANNLab默认已提供最新版本CANN对应的源码。 ## 📖学习教程 - [快速入门](docs/QUICKSTART.md)：从零开始快速体验项目核心基础能力，涵盖源码编译、算子调用、开发与调试等操作。 - [进阶教程](docs/README.md)：如需深入了解项目编译部署、算子调用、开发、调试调优等能力，请查阅文档中心获取详细指引。 ## 💬相关信息 - [目录结构](docs/zh/install/dir_structure.md) - [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) - **社区互动**：通过GitCode[【讨论】](https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer/discussions)参与交流。 - **技术专栏**：通过GitCode[【Wiki】](https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer/wiki)获取技术文章，如系列化教程、优秀实践等。 ​

480	    local success_files=$(find . -type f -name "success_ops.log")
481	
482	    declare -A failed_ops_map
483	    declare -A success_ops_map

485	    if [[ -n "$failed_files" ]]; then
486	        while IFS= read -r file; do
487	            [[ -s "$file" ]] || continue
488	            while IFS= read -r line; do
489	                [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
490	                local op_name=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
491	                local bin_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
492	                if [[ -n "$op_name" && -n "$bin_name" ]]; then

494	                        failed_ops_map["$op_name"]="$bin_name"
495	                    else
496	                        failed_ops_map["$op_name"]="${failed_ops_map[$op_name]}\\n$bin_name"
497	                    fi
498	                fi
499	            done < "$file"
500	        done <<< "$failed_files"
501	    fi
502	
503	    if [[ -n "$success_files" ]]; then
504	        while IFS= read -r file; do
505	            [[ -s "$file" ]] || continue
506	            while IFS= read -r line; do
507	                [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
508	                local op_name=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
509	                local bin_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
510	                if [[ -n "$op_name" && -n "$bin_name" ]]; then
511	                    if [[ -z "${success_ops_map[$op_name]}" ]]; then
512	                        success_ops_map["$op_name"]="$bin_name"
513	                    else
514	                        success_ops_map["$op_name"]="${success_ops_map[$op_name]}\\n$bin_name"
515	                    fi
516	                fi
517	            done < "$file"
518	        done <<< "$success_files"
519	    fi
520	
521	    if [[ ${#success_ops_map[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
522	        echo "All CI compile success ops:"
523	        for op_name in "${!success_ops_map[@]}"; do
524	            local bin_list="${success_ops_map[$op_name]}"

574	function build_example()
575	{
576	    log "Start to run example,name:${EXAMPLE_NAME} mode:${EXAMPLE_MODE}"
577	
578	    local verbose_option=""
579	    if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ];then
580	        verbose_option="-v"
581	    fi
582	
583	    if [ ! -d "${BUILD_PATH}" ]; then
584	    	mkdir -p ${BUILD_PATH}
585	    fi

587	    # 清理CMake缓存
588	    # clean_cmake_cache
589	    clean
590	
591	    cd "${BUILD_PATH}"
592	    if [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "eager" ]]; then
593	        pattern="test_aclnn_"
594	    elif [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "graph" ]]; then
595	        pattern="test_geir_"
596	    fi
597	    # No soc provided.
598	    if [[ -z "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" ]]; then
599	        ASCEND_SOC_UNITS="ascend910b"
600	    fi
601	    is_soc_support=""
602	    for support_unit in "${SUPPORT_COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT[@]}"; do
603	        if [[ "$support_unit" == "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" ]]; then
604	            is_soc_support="true"
605	            break
606	        fi
607	    done
608	    if [[ -z "$is_soc_support" ]]; then
609	        echo "Currently $ASCEND_SOC_UNITS is not supported, please input a valid soc."
610	        return 1
611	    fi
612	    # Obtain the example file corresponding to the input soc unit.
613	    if [[ "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" == "ascend950" ]]; then
614	        # 1. ascend950/ascend950 example is independent of other soc units.
615	        files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/arch35/${pattern}*.cpp"))
616	        if [[ -z "$files" ]]; then
617	            # 2. Example is shared with other soc units, or the current operator only supports ascend950/ascend950.
618	            files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/${pattern}*.cpp"))
619	        fi
620	    else
621	        # Except for ascend950/ascend950, the examples of other soc units are temporarily shared.
622	        # If you need to add independent examples, you can refer to the method of adding a directory for isolation.
623	        files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/${pattern}*.cpp"))
624	    fi
625	    # Compile and Execute
626	    if [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "eager" ]]; then
627	        if [ -z "$files" ]; then
628	            echo "${EXAMPLE_NAME} do not have eager example"
629	            return 2
630	        fi
631	        ABSOLUTE_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../mc2) # mc2目录绝对路径
632	        ABSOLUTE_EXAMPLES_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../examples/mc2)
633	        ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENTAL_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../experimental/mc2)
634	        found_specific_example=false
635	        for file in "${files[@]}"; do
636	            # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名，只运行该文件
637	            if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" ]]; then
638	                file_basename=$(basename "$file" .cpp)
639	                specific_name_without_suffix="${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME%.cpp}"
640	                # 如果不以 pattern 开头，自动加上 pattern
641	                if [[ ! "${specific_name_without_suffix}" =~ ^${pattern} ]]; then
642	                    specific_name_without_suffix="${pattern}${specific_name_without_suffix}"
643	                fi
644	                if [[ "${file_basename}" != "${specific_name_without_suffix}" ]]; then
645	                    continue
646	                fi
647	                found_specific_example=true
648	            fi
649	            echo "Start compile and run example file: $file"
650	            REAL_FILE_PATH=$(realpath "$file")
651	            MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY=""
652	            if [[ "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_MC2_PATH}"* || "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_EXAMPLES_MC2_PATH}"* || "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENTAL_MC2_PATH}"* ]]; then
653	                MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY="-lpthread -Wl,--no-as-needed -lhccl -lhccl_fwk"
654	            fi
655	            if [[ "${PKG_MODE}" == "" ]]; then
656	                g++ ${verbose_option} ${file} \
657	                    -I ${INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${ACLNN_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${EAGER_INCLUDE_OPP_ACLNNOP_PATH} \
658	                    -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_OPP_PATH} -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_PATH} \
659	                    -lopapi_math -lopapi_transformer -lascendcl -lnnopbase \
660	                    -lc_sec ${MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY} \
661	                    -o test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
662	            elif [[ "${PKG_MODE}" == "cust" ]]; then
663	                if [[ "${vendor_name}" == "" ]]; then
664	                    vendor_name="custom"
665	                fi
666	                echo "pkg_mode:${PKG_MODE} vendor_name:${vendor_name}"
667	                export CUST_LIBRARY_PATH="${ASCEND_OPP_PATH}/vendors/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/lib"     # 仅自定义算子需要
668	                export CUST_INCLUDE_PATH="${ASCEND_OPP_PATH}/vendors/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/include" # 仅自定义算子需要
669	                if [[ -n "${ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH}" ]]; then
670	                    CUST_VENDORS_PATH=$(dirname "${ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH%%:*}")
671	                    CUST_LIBRARY_PATH="${CUST_VENDORS_PATH}/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/lib"
672	                    CUST_INCLUDE_PATH="${CUST_VENDORS_PATH}/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/include"
673	                fi
674	                g++ ${verbose_option} ${file} \
675	                    -I ${CUST_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${INCLUDE_PATH} \
676	                    -L ${CUST_LIBRARY_PATH} -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_PATH} \
677	                    -lopapi_math -lcust_opapi -lascendcl -lnnopbase \
678	                    -I ${EAGER_INCLUDE_OPP_ACLNNOP_PATH} \
679	                    -lc_sec ${MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY} \
680	                    -o test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME} \
681	                    -Wl,-rpath=${CUST_LIBRARY_PATH}
682	            else
683	                echo "Error: pkg_mode(${PKG_MODE}) must be cust."
684	                help_info "run_example"
685	                return 1
686	            fi
687	            if [[ "${SIMULATOR}" == "camodel" && "${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS}" == "ascend950" ]]; then
688	                cannsim record -s Ascend950 ./test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME} --gen-report
689	            else
690	                ./test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
691	            fi
692	            run_result=$?
693	            if [ $run_result -ne 0 ]; then
694	                echo "run test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples failed"
695	                return $run_result
696	            else
697	                echo "run test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples success"
698	            fi
699	        done
700	        # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名但没有找到，给出错误提示
701	        if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" && "${found_specific_example}" == "false" ]]; then
702	            echo "Error: Specified example '${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}' not found in ${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/"
703	            return 2
704	        fi
705	    elif [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "graph" ]]; then
706	        if [ -z "$files" ]; then
707	            echo "${EXAMPLE_NAME} do not have graph example"
708	            return 2
709	        fi
710	        found_specific_example=false
711	        for file in "${files[@]}"; do
712	            # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名，只运行该文件
713	            if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" ]]; then
714	                file_basename=$(basename "$file" .cpp)

716	                # 如果不以 pattern 开头，自动加上 pattern (支持 operator name 格式)
717	                if [[ ! "${specific_name_without_suffix}" =~ ^${pattern} ]]; then
718	                    specific_name_without_suffix="${pattern}${specific_name_without_suffix}"
719	                fi
720	                if [[ "${file_basename}" != "${specific_name_without_suffix}" ]]; then
721	                    continue
722	                fi
723	                found_specific_example=true
724	            fi
725	            echo "Start compile and run example file: $file"

727	            ./test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
728	            run_result=$?
729	            if [ $run_result -ne 0 ]; then
730	                echo "run test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples failed"
731	                return $run_result
732	            else
733	                echo "run test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples success"
734	            fi
735	        done
736	        # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名但没有找到，给出错误提示
737	        if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" && "${found_specific_example}" == "false" ]]; then
738	            echo "Error: Specified example '${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}' not found in ${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/"
739	            return 2
740	        fi
741	    else
742	        help_info "run_example"

function log() {
    local current_time=`date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"`
    echo "[$current_time] "$1
}

check_pkg_type() {
  local pkg_type="$1"
  if [[ "$pkg_type" != "run" && "$pkg_type" != "rpm" && "$pkg_type" != "deb" && "$pkg_type" != "all" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] --pkg-type only supports run/rpm/deb/all, got: $pkg_type"
    exit 1
  fi
}

function set_env()
{
    source $ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH/bin/setenv.bash || echo "0"

    export BISHENG_REAL_PATH=$(which bisheng || true)

    if [ -z "${BISHENG_REAL_PATH}" ];then
        if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]] && [[ "$ENABLE_AICPU" == "FALSE" ]] ; then
            log "Warning: bisheng compilation tool not found, but --jit --noaicpu is enabled, so continue."
            return
        fi
        log "Error: bisheng compilation tool not found, Please check whether the cann package or environment variables are set."
        exit 1
    fi
}

function clean()
{
    if [ -n "${BUILD_DIR}" ];then
        rm -rf ${BUILD_DIR}
    fi

    if [ -z "${TEST}" ] && [ -z "${EXAMPLE}" ];then
        if [ -n "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ];then
            rm -rf ${OUTPUT_DIR}
        fi
    fi

    mkdir -p ${BUILD_DIR} ${OUTPUT_DIR}
}

function ensure_build_dirs()
{
    mkdir -p ${BUILD_DIR} ${OUTPUT_DIR}
}

function clean_build_out()
{
    if [ -n "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}" ];then
        rm -rf ${BUILD_OUT_DIR}
    fi

    mkdir -p ${BUILD_OUT_DIR}
}

function clean_third_party()
{
    THIRD_PARTY_PATH=${BASE_PATH}/third_party
    if [ -d "${THIRD_PARTY_PATH}" ]; then
        rm -rf ${THIRD_PARTY_PATH}/abseil-cpp
        rm -rf ${THIRD_PARTY_PATH}/ascend_protobuf
    fi
}

function cmake_config()
{
    local extra_option="$1"
    log "Info: cmake config ${CUSTOM_OPTION} ${extra_option} ."
    cmake ..  ${CUSTOM_OPTION} ${extra_option}
}

function ci_print_compile_failed_ops_info()
{
    local failed_files=$(find . -type f -name "failed_ops.log")
    local success_files=$(find . -type f -name "success_ops.log")

    declare -A failed_ops_map
    declare -A success_ops_map

    if [[ -n "$failed_files" ]]; then
        while IFS= read -r file; do
            [[ -s "$file" ]] || continue
            while IFS= read -r line; do
                [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
                local op_name=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
                local bin_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
                if [[ -n "$op_name" && -n "$bin_name" ]]; then
                    if [[ -z "${failed_ops_map[$op_name]}" ]]; then
                        failed_ops_map["$op_name"]="$bin_name"
                    else
                        failed_ops_map["$op_name"]="${failed_ops_map[$op_name]}\\n$bin_name"
                    fi
                fi
            done < "$file"
        done <<< "$failed_files"
    fi

    if [[ -n "$success_files" ]]; then
        while IFS= read -r file; do
            [[ -s "$file" ]] || continue
            while IFS= read -r line; do
                [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
                local op_name=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
                local bin_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
                if [[ -n "$op_name" && -n "$bin_name" ]]; then
                    if [[ -z "${success_ops_map[$op_name]}" ]]; then
                        success_ops_map["$op_name"]="$bin_name"
                    else
                        success_ops_map["$op_name"]="${success_ops_map[$op_name]}\\n$bin_name"
                    fi
                fi
            done < "$file"
        done <<< "$success_files"
    fi

    if [[ ${#success_ops_map[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "All CI compile success ops:"
        for op_name in "${!success_ops_map[@]}"; do
            local bin_list="${success_ops_map[$op_name]}"
            echo "ops name: $op_name, success bin: $bin_list"
        done
    fi
    if [[ ${#failed_ops_map[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "All CI compile failed ops:"
        for op_name in "${!failed_ops_map[@]}"; do
            local bin_list="${failed_ops_map[$op_name]}"
            echo "ops name: $op_name, failed bin: $bin_list"
        done
        echo "[ERROR] build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

function build()
{
    local target="$1"
    if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ];then
        local option="--verbose"
    fi
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${BUILD_DIR}:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
    if [[ "$CI_MODE" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        export CI_MODE=TRUE
        set +e
        cmake --build . --target ${target} ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
        set -e
    else
        cmake --build . --target ${target} ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
    fi
    ci_print_compile_failed_ops_info
}

    fi

    # 清理CMake缓存
    # clean_cmake_cache
    clean

    cd "${BUILD_PATH}"
    if [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "eager" ]]; then
        pattern="test_aclnn_"
    elif [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "graph" ]]; then
        pattern="test_geir_"
    fi
    # No soc provided.
    if [[ -z "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" ]]; then
        ASCEND_SOC_UNITS="ascend910b"
    fi
    is_soc_support=""
    for support_unit in "${SUPPORT_COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$support_unit" == "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" ]]; then
            is_soc_support="true"
            break
        fi
    done
    if [[ -z "$is_soc_support" ]]; then
        echo "Currently $ASCEND_SOC_UNITS is not supported, please input a valid soc."
        return 1
    fi
    # Obtain the example file corresponding to the input soc unit.
    if [[ "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS" == "ascend950" ]]; then
        # 1. ascend950/ascend950 example is independent of other soc units.
        files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/arch35/${pattern}*.cpp"))
        if [[ -z "$files" ]]; then
            # 2. Example is shared with other soc units, or the current operator only supports ascend950/ascend950.
            files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/${pattern}*.cpp"))
        fi
    else
        # Except for ascend950/ascend950, the examples of other soc units are temporarily shared.
        # If you need to add independent examples, you can refer to the method of adding a directory for isolation.
        files=($(find ../ -path "*/${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/${pattern}*.cpp"))
    fi
    # Compile and Execute
    if [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "eager" ]]; then
        if [ -z "$files" ]; then
            echo "${EXAMPLE_NAME} do not have eager example"
            return 2
        fi
        ABSOLUTE_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../mc2) # mc2目录绝对路径
        ABSOLUTE_EXAMPLES_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../examples/mc2)
        ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENTAL_MC2_PATH=$(realpath ${BUILD_PATH}/../experimental/mc2)
        found_specific_example=false
        for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名，只运行该文件
            if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" ]]; then
                file_basename=$(basename "$file" .cpp)
                specific_name_without_suffix="${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME%.cpp}"
                # 如果不以 pattern 开头，自动加上 pattern
                if [[ ! "${specific_name_without_suffix}" =~ ^${pattern} ]]; then
                    specific_name_without_suffix="${pattern}${specific_name_without_suffix}"
                fi
                if [[ "${file_basename}" != "${specific_name_without_suffix}" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                found_specific_example=true
            fi
            echo "Start compile and run example file: $file"
            REAL_FILE_PATH=$(realpath "$file")
            MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY=""
            if [[ "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_MC2_PATH}"* || "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_EXAMPLES_MC2_PATH}"* || "$REAL_FILE_PATH" == "${ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENTAL_MC2_PATH}"* ]]; then
                MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY="-lpthread -Wl,--no-as-needed -lhccl -lhccl_fwk"
            fi
            if [[ "${PKG_MODE}" == "" ]]; then
                g++ ${verbose_option} ${file} \
                    -I ${INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${ACLNN_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${EAGER_INCLUDE_OPP_ACLNNOP_PATH} \
                    -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_OPP_PATH} -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_PATH} \
                    -lopapi_math -lopapi_transformer -lascendcl -lnnopbase \
                    -lc_sec ${MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY} \
                    -o test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
            elif [[ "${PKG_MODE}" == "cust" ]]; then
                if [[ "${vendor_name}" == "" ]]; then
                    vendor_name="custom"
                fi
                echo "pkg_mode:${PKG_MODE} vendor_name:${vendor_name}"
                export CUST_LIBRARY_PATH="${ASCEND_OPP_PATH}/vendors/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/lib"     # 仅自定义算子需要
                export CUST_INCLUDE_PATH="${ASCEND_OPP_PATH}/vendors/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/include" # 仅自定义算子需要
                if [[ -n "${ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH}" ]]; then
                    CUST_VENDORS_PATH=$(dirname "${ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH%%:*}")
                    CUST_LIBRARY_PATH="${CUST_VENDORS_PATH}/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/lib"
                    CUST_INCLUDE_PATH="${CUST_VENDORS_PATH}/${vendor_name}_transformer/op_api/include"
                fi
                g++ ${verbose_option} ${file} \
                    -I ${CUST_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${INCLUDE_PATH} \
                    -L ${CUST_LIBRARY_PATH} -L ${EAGER_LIBRARY_PATH} \
                    -lopapi_math -lcust_opapi -lascendcl -lnnopbase \
                    -I ${EAGER_INCLUDE_OPP_ACLNNOP_PATH} \
                    -lc_sec ${MC2_APPEND_INCLUDE_AND_LIBRARY} \
                    -o test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME} \
                    -Wl,-rpath=${CUST_LIBRARY_PATH}
            else
                echo "Error: pkg_mode(${PKG_MODE}) must be cust."
                help_info "run_example"
                return 1
            fi
            if [[ "${SIMULATOR}" == "camodel" && "${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS}" == "ascend950" ]]; then
                cannsim record -s Ascend950 ./test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME} --gen-report
            else
                ./test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
            fi
            run_result=$?
            if [ $run_result -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "run test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples failed"
                return $run_result
            else
                echo "run test_aclnn_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples success"
            fi
        done
        # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名但没有找到，给出错误提示
        if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" && "${found_specific_example}" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Specified example '${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}' not found in ${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/"
            return 2
        fi
    elif [[ "${EXAMPLE_MODE}" == "graph" ]]; then
        if [ -z "$files" ]; then
            echo "${EXAMPLE_NAME} do not have graph example"
            return 2
        fi
        found_specific_example=false
        for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名，只运行该文件
            if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" ]]; then
                file_basename=$(basename "$file" .cpp)
                specific_name_without_suffix="${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME%.cpp}"
                # 如果不以 pattern 开头，自动加上 pattern (支持 operator name 格式)
                if [[ ! "${specific_name_without_suffix}" =~ ^${pattern} ]]; then
                    specific_name_without_suffix="${pattern}${specific_name_without_suffix}"
                fi
                if [[ "${file_basename}" != "${specific_name_without_suffix}" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                found_specific_example=true
            fi
            echo "Start compile and run example file: $file"
            g++ ${verbose_option} ${file} -I ${GRAPH_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${GE_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${LINUX_INCLUDE_PATH} -I ${INC_INCLUDE_PATH} -L ${GRAPH_LIBRARY_STUB_PATH} -L ${GRAPH_LIBRARY_PATH} -lgraph -lge_runner -lgraph_base -lge_compiler -o test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
            ./test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}
            run_result=$?
            if [ $run_result -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "run test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples failed"
                return $run_result
            else
                echo "run test_geir_${EXAMPLE_NAME}, execute samples success"
            fi
        done
        # 如果指定了特定的 example 文件名但没有找到，给出错误提示
        if [[ -n "${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}" && "${found_specific_example}" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Specified example '${SPECIFIC_EXAMPLE_NAME}' not found in ${EXAMPLE_NAME}/examples/"
            return 2
        fi
    else
        help_info "run_example"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

function find_rpm_deb_package() {
    if [[ "$PACKAGE_TYPE" == "run" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    find "${BUILD_PATH}" -type f -name "cann-*-ops-transformer*.${PACKAGE_TYPE}" | sort
}

function clean_rpm_deb_package() {
    if [[ "$PACKAGE_TYPE" == "run" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    local package_files=()
    while IFS= read -r package_file; do
        package_files+=("${package_file}")
    done < <(find_rpm_deb_package)

    if [[ ${#package_files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    for package_file in "${package_files[@]}"; do
        rm -f "${package_file}"
        echo "[INFO] Removed stale package artifact: ${package_file}"
    done
}

function collect_rpm_deb_package() {
    if [[ "$PACKAGE_TYPE" == "run" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    local package_files=()
    while IFS= read -r package_file; do
        package_files+=("${package_file}")
    done < <(find_rpm_deb_package)

    if [[ ${#package_files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] No .${PACKAGE_TYPE} package found in ${BUILD_PATH}"
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}"
    fi
    for package_file in "${package_files[@]}"; do
        cp -f "${package_file}" "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}/"
        echo "[INFO] Package artifact copied to ${BUILD_OUT_DIR}/$(basename "${package_file}")"
    done
}

function build_package(){
    if [[ "${PACKAGE_TYPE}" == "all" ]]; then
        local saved_pkg_type="${PACKAGE_TYPE}"
        local option=""
        if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ]; then
            option="--verbose"
        fi
        for PACKAGE_TYPE in run rpm deb; do
            clean_rpm_deb_package
            cmake -DPACKAGE_TYPE="${PACKAGE_TYPE}" "${BUILD_PATH}" > /dev/null 2>&1
            cmake --build . --target package ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "[ERROR] target:package (${PACKAGE_TYPE}) build failed!"
                exit 1
            fi
            collect_rpm_deb_package
        done
        PACKAGE_TYPE="${saved_pkg_type}"
    else
        clean_rpm_deb_package
        build package
        collect_rpm_deb_package
    fi
}

function build_host(){
    build_package
}

    build ops_transformer_kernel

function build_torch_extension_whl() {
    local torch_ext_dir="${CURRENT_DIR}/torch_extension"
    local original_dir=$(pwd)
    if [ -d "${torch_ext_dir}" ]; then
        log "[INFO] Building torch_extension whl package..."
        cd "${torch_ext_dir}"

        # 检查 build 模块是否可用
        if ! python3 -c "import build" 2>/dev/null; then
            log "[WARNING] Python build module not found, skipping whl build"
            cd "${original_dir}"
            return 0
        fi

        python3 -m build --wheel -n 2>&1 || {
            log "[ERROR] Failed to build torch_extension whl package"
            cd "${original_dir}"
            return 1
        }
        cd "${original_dir}"
        log "[INFO] torch_extension whl package built successfully"
    fi
}

build_static_lib() {
    local unit="$1"
    echo $dotted_line
    echo "Start to build static lib."

    local option=""
    if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ]; then
        option="--verbose"
    fi

    cd "${BUILD_PATH}" && cmake ${CUSTOM_OPTION} .. -DENABLE_STATIC=ON -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${unit}
    local all_targets=$(cmake --build . --target help)
    rm -fr ${BUILD_PATH}/bin_tmp
    mkdir -p ${BUILD_PATH}/bin_tmp
    if echo "${all_targets}" | grep -wq "ophost_transformer_static"; then
        cmake --build . --target ophost_transformer_static ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
    fi
    cmake --build . --target opapi_transformer_static ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
    local jit_command=""
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        jit_command="-j"
    fi

    rm -fr ${BUILD_PATH}/autogen/${unit}
    python3 "${BASE_PATH}/scripts/util/build_opp_kernel_static.py" GenStaticOpResourceIni -s ${unit} -b ${BUILD_PATH} ${jit_command}
    python3 "${BASE_PATH}/scripts/util/build_opp_kernel_static.py" StaticCompile -s ${unit} -b ${BUILD_PATH} -n=0 -a=${ARCH_INFO} ${jit_command}

    cd "${BUILD_PATH}" && cmake ${CUSTOM_OPTION} .. -DENABLE_STATIC=ON -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${unit}
    cmake --build . --target cann_transformer_static ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
    echo "Build static lib success!"
}

package_static() {
    local unit="$1"
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_CUSTOM" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=OFF -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON"
    else
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=ON -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON"
    fi
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=OFF"
    else
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=ON"
    fi
    cmake_config -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${unit}
    build_package
    # Check weather BUILD_OUT_DIR directory exists
    if [ ! -d "$BUILD_OUT_DIR" ]; then
        echo "Error: Directory $BUILD_OUT_DIR does not exist."
        return 1
    fi

    # Check weather *.run is exists and verify the file numbers
    local run_files=("$BUILD_OUT_DIR"/*.run)
    if [ ${#run_files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: No .run files found in $BUILD_OUT_DIR directory."
        return 1
    fi
    if [ ${#run_files[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
        echo "Error: Multiple .run files found in $BUILD_OUT_DIR directory."
        printf '%s\n' "${run_files[@]}"
        return 1
    fi
    # Get filename of *.run file and set new directory name
    local run_file=$(basename "${run_files[0]}")
    echo "Found .run file: $run_file"
    if [[ "$run_file" != *"ops-transformer"* ]]; then
        echo "Error: Filename '$run_file' does not contain 'ops-transformer'."
        return 1
    fi
    local static_name="${run_file/ops-transformer/ops-transformer-static}"
    static_name="${static_name%.run}"

    # Check weather $BUILD_PATH/static_library_files directory exists and not empty
    local static_files_dir="$BUILD_PATH/static_library_files"
    if [ ! -d "$static_files_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Directory $static_files_dir does not exist."
        return 1
    fi
    if [ -z "$(ls -A "$static_files_dir")" ]; then
        echo "Error: Directory $static_files_dir is empty."
        return 1
    fi

    # Rename directory
    local new_dir_path="$BUILD_PATH/$static_name"
    if mv "$static_files_dir" "$new_dir_path"; then
        echo "Preparing for packaging: renamed $static_files_dir to $new_dir_path"
    else
        echo "Packaging preparation failed: directory rename failed ($static_files_dir -> $new_dir_path)"
        return 1
    fi

    # Create compressed package and restore directory name
    local new_filename="${static_name}.tar.gz"
    if tar -czf "$BUILD_OUT_DIR/$new_filename" -C "$BUILD_PATH" "$static_name"; then
        echo "[SUCCESS] Build static lib success!"
        echo "Successfully created compressed package: $BUILD_OUT_DIR/$new_filename"
        # Restore original directory name
        echo "Restoring original directory name: $new_dir_path -> $static_files_dir"
        mv "$new_dir_path" "$static_files_dir"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to create compressed package."
        # Attempt to restore original directory name
        mv "$new_dir_path" "$static_files_dir"
        return 1
    fi
}

function process_soc_input(){
    local input_string="$1"
    local value_part="${input_string#*=}"
    ASCEND_SOC_UNITS="${value_part//,/;}"

    # 校验 --soc 输入的每个 SoC 名称, 任一非法立即报错退出
    if ! validate_soc_list "${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS}"; then
        if [[ -z "${INVALID_SOC_ITEM}" ]]; then
            echo "[ERROR] The input soc is empty or contains empty items. Please use one of: $(get_supported_soc_text)"
        else
            echo "[ERROR] The input soc ${INVALID_SOC_ITEM} is not supported. Please use one of: $(get_supported_soc_text)"
        fi
        exit 1
    fi

    # 归一化为小写, 与 CMakeLists.txt 中 SOC_VERSION_LIST 的大小写敏感精确匹配保持一致
    ASCEND_SOC_UNITS="${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS,,}"

    declare -A SOC_HARDWARE_MAP=(
        # 命名依据: README.md(Atlas A2/A3系列产品, Ascend 950PR/Ascend 950DT, KirinX90系列产品)
        # 与 cmake/scripts/util/const_var.py 的 SOC_MAP_EXT
        [ascend910b]="Atlas A2"
        [ascend910_93]="Atlas A3"
        [ascend310p]="Ascend310P3"
        [ascend950]="Ascend 950PR/Ascend 950DT"
        [kirinx90]="KirinX90"
        [kirin9030]="Kirin9030"
        # mc62 在本仓 README/docs/const_var.py 及 ops-nn 仓中均无官方产品命名, 暂不配置, 走通用提示
    )

    if [[ ${SOC_HARDWARE_MAP[$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS]} ]]; then
        echo "Warning: The current environment is configured for $ASCEND_SOC_UNITS, Please use ${SOC_HARDWARE_MAP[$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS]} series hardware for optimal performance."
    else
        echo "Warning: Hardware type '$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS' detected. Please ensure you are using compatible hardware."
    fi
}

process_genop() {
    local opt_name=$1
    local genop_value=$2

    if [[ "$opt_name" == "genop" ]]; then
        ENABLE_GENOP=TRUE
    elif [[ "$opt_name" == "genop_aicpu" ]]; then
        ENABLE_GENOP_AICPU=TRUE
    else
        usage "genop"
        exit 1
    fi

    if [[ "$genop_value" != *"/"* ]] || [[ "$genop_value" == *"/" ]]; then
        usage "$opt_name"
        exit 1
    fi

    GENOP_NAME=${genop_value##*/}
    local remaining=${genop_value%/*}

    if [[ "$remaining" != *"/"* ]]; then
        GENOP_TYPE=$remaining
        GENOP_BASE=${BASE_PATH}
    else
        GENOP_TYPE=${remaining##*/}
        GENOP_BASE=${remaining%/*}
        if [[ ! "$GENOP_BASE" =~ ^/ && ! "$GENOP_BASE" =~ ^[a-zA-Z]: ]]; then
        GENOP_BASE="${BASE_PATH}/${GENOP_BASE}"
        fi
    fi
}

set_ut_mode() {
  REPOSITORY_NAME="transformer"
  if [[ "$ENABLE_TEST" != "TRUE" ]]; then
    return
  fi
  if [ -n "${PR_CHANGED_FILES}" ]; then
    OP_HOST_UT=TRUE
    OP_API_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_host_ut")
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_api_ut")
    return
  fi
  UT_TEST_ALL=TRUE
  if [[ "$OP_HOST" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_HOST_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_API" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_API_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_GRAPH" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_GRAPH_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_KERNEL" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_KERNEL_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]] || [[ "$OP_HOST_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_host_ut")
  fi
  if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]] || [[ "$OP_API_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_api_ut")
  fi
  if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]] || [[ "$OP_GRAPH_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_graph_ut")
  fi
  if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]] || [[ "$OP_KERNEL_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    UT_TARGETS+=("${REPOSITORY_NAME}_op_kernel_ut")
  fi
  if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]] && [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_CUSTOM" != "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_HOST_UT=TRUE
    OP_API_UT=TRUE
    OP_GRAPH_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
    OP_KERNEL_UT=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_KERNEL_UT" == "TRUE" ]] && [[ -z "$ascend_op_name" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: Please use --ops when running Opkernel UT."

parse_changed_files() {
    if [[ -z "$PR_CHANGED_FILES" ]]; then
        return

    if [[ "$PR_CHANGED_FILES" != /* ]]; then
        PR_CHANGED_FILES=$PWD/$PR_CHANGED_FILES
    fi

    echo "changed files is" $PR_CHANGED_FILES
    echo $dotted_line
    cat $PR_CHANGED_FILES
    ops_names=$(python3 scripts/ci/parse_changed_ops.py $PR_CHANGED_FILES "$ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL" "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS")

check_option_validity() {
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [[ "$arg" =~ ^- ]]; then
      if [[ "$arg" =~ ^-- ]]; then
        local long_opt="${arg:2}"
        local opt_name="${long_opt%%=*}"
        local found=false
        for supported_opt in "${SUPPORTED_LONG_OPTS[@]}"; do
          if [[ "$supported_opt" =~ =$ ]]; then
            local base_opt="${supported_opt%=}"
            if [[ "$opt_name" == "$base_opt" ]]; then
              found=true
              break
            fi
          else
            if [[ "$opt_name" == "$supported_opt" ]]; then
              found=true
              break
            fi
          fi
        done
        if [[ "$found" == "false" ]]; then
          echo "[ERROR] Invalid option: --$opt_name"
          echo "Use 'bash build.sh --help' for more information."
          exit 1
        fi
      fi
    fi
  done
}

check_param() {
  if [[ "$ENABLE_MSSANITIZER" == "TRUE" && "$OOM" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] --mssanitizer cannot be used with --oom"
    exit 1
  fi

  if [[ "$ENABLE_MSSANITIZER" == "TRUE" && "$ENABLE_DUMP_CCE" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] --mssanitizer cannot be used with --dump_cce"
    exit 1
  fi

  if [ -n "$BISHENG_FLAGS" ]; then
    if [[ "$ENABLE_MSSANITIZER" == "TRUE" || "$OOM" == "true" || "$ENABLE_DUMP_CCE" == "TRUE" ]]; then
      echo "[ERROR] --bisheng_flags= cannot be used with --mssanitizer, --oom, --dump_cce"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi

  if [[ "$BUILD_TYPE" == "Debug" ]]; then
    if [[ "$ENABLE_MSSANITIZER" == "TRUE" || "$OOM" == "true" || "$ENABLE_DUMP_CCE" == "TRUE" ]]; then
      echo "[ERROR] --build-type=Debug cannot be used with --mssanitizer, --oom, --dump_cce"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi

  if [ -n "$KERNEL_TEMPLATE_INPUT" ]; then
    if [[ -z "${ascend_op_name}" || "$ascend_op_name" == *","* ]]; then
      echo "[ERROR] --kernel_template_input must be used with --ops= and can only specify a single operator"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
}

    --pkg-type=*)

    --genop=*)

    --genop_aicpu=*)

done
set_ut_mode

check_param

if [[ "$PACKAGE_TYPE_SET" == "TRUE" && "$ENABLE_BUILD_PKG" != "TRUE" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] --pkg-type can only be used with --pkg"
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$PACKAGE_TYPE" != "run" && "$PACKAGE_TYPE" != "all" ]]; then
    if [[ "$ENABLE_STATIC" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] --pkg-type=${PACKAGE_TYPE} cannot be used with --static"
        exit 1
    fi
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] --pkg-type=${PACKAGE_TYPE} cannot be used with --jit"
        exit 1
    fi

        echo "[ERROR] --pkg-type=${PACKAGE_TYPE} only supports built-in ops-transformer packages; do not use --ops, --vendor_name, or --experimental"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

assemble_cmake_args

function get_cpu_num() {
    CPU_NUM=$(($(cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep "^processor" | wc -l)*2))
    if [ -n "${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}" ]; then
        if [[ "${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            CPU_NUM="${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}"
        fi
    fi
}

if [ "${PARENT_JOB}" == "false" ]; then
    get_cpu_num
    JOB_NUM="-j${CPU_NUM}"
fi

if [ -n "${INPUT_JOB_NUM}" ]; then
    get_cpu_num
    JOB_NUM="-j${INPUT_JOB_NUM}"
fi

# 非打包命令调用，打包模式会打进同一个包里
function set_compute_unit_option() {
    # 使用共享校验库逐项校验 SoC 列表(支持逗号/分号分隔的多个 soc), 替换原有的整串精确匹配
    if ! validate_soc_list "${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS}"; then
        echo "[ERROR] The input soc ${INVALID_SOC_ITEM} is not supported. Please use one of: $(get_supported_soc_text)"
        exit 1
    fi
    CUSTOM_OPTION="$CUSTOM_OPTION -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS"
}

# 上面的set_compute_unit_option修改成只能传入一个soc后导致ut有问题，现在复制一份旧的支持多个soc传入，用于ut
function set_compute_unit_option_ut() {
    IFS=';' read -ra SOC_ARRAY <<< "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS"  # 分割字符串为数组
    local COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT=""
    local soc=""
    local trimmed_soc=""
    for soc in "${SOC_ARRAY[@]}"; do
        # 裁剪前后空白后, 通过共享校验库逐项精确匹配(替换原有错误的子串匹配逻辑)
        trimmed_soc="${soc#"${soc%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
        trimmed_soc="${trimmed_soc%"${trimmed_soc##*[![:space:]]}"}"
        if soc_is_supported "${trimmed_soc}"; then
            COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT="${COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT}${trimmed_soc,,};"
        fi
    done
    if [[ -z "${COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT}" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] The input soc ${ASCEND_SOC_UNITS} is not supported. Please use one of: $(get_supported_soc_text)"
        exit 1
    fi
    CUSTOM_OPTION="$CUSTOM_OPTION -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=$COMPUTE_UNIT_SHORT"
 }

########################################################################################################################
# 处理流程
########################################################################################################################

set_env

if [[ "${INCREMENTAL_BUILD}" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    log "Info: incremental build enabled, keep existing build/output directories."
    ensure_build_dirs
else
    clean
fi

if [ -n "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" ]; then
    if [ "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" == "false" ] || [ "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" == "off" ]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=OFF"
    elif [ -f "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=ON -DCUSTOM_CCACHE=${CCACHE_PROGRAM}"
        export ASCENDC_CCACHE_EXECUTABLE=${CCACHE_PROGRAM}
    fi
else
    # 判断有无默认的ccache 如果有则使用
    ccache_system=$(which ccache || true)
    if [ -n "${ccache_system}" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=ON -DCUSTOM_CCACHE=${ccache_system}"
        export ASCENDC_CCACHE_EXECUTABLE=${ccache_system}
    fi
fi
build_ut() {
  CORE_NUMS=$(cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep "processor" | wc -l)
  dotted_line="----------------------------------------------------------------"
  echo $dotted_line
  echo "Start to build ut"

  if [ ! -d "${BUILD_DIR}" ]; then
    mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}"
  fi
  cd "${BUILD_DIR}" && cmake ${CUSTOM_OPTION} ..

  local target="$1"
  if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ]; then
    local option="--verbose"
  fi
  if [ $(cmake -LA -N . | grep 'UTEST_FRAMEWORK_OLD:BOOL=' | cut -d'=' -f2) == "TRUE" ]; then
    cmake --build . --target ${target} ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
  fi

  if [ $(cmake -LA -N . | grep 'UTEST_FRAMEWORK_NEW:BOOL=' | cut -d'=' -f2) == "TRUE" ]; then
    local has_valid_target="FALSE"
    for UT_TARGET in ${UT_TARGETS[@]} ; do
        if cmake --build . --target help | grep -w "$UT_TARGET"; then
            echo "Building target: $UT_TARGET."
            if ! cmake --build . --target ${UT_TARGET} -j $CORE_NUMS; then
                echo "[ERROR] Build failed for target: $UT_TARGET."
                exit 1
            fi
            has_valid_target="TRUE"
        else
            echo "Target $UT_TARGET not found, skipping build."
        fi
    done
    if [[ "$COV" == "true" && "$ENABLE_UT_EXEC" == "TRUE" && "$has_valid_target" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        python3 ${BASE_PATH}/cmake/scripts/utest/gen_coverage.py \
            -s=${BASE_PATH} \
            -c=${BUILD_PATH} \
            -f="/tmp/*" \
            -f="/usr/include/*" \
            -f="$(realpath $ASCEND_HOME_PATH/../)/*" \
            -y=${BASE_PATH}/tests/test_config.yaml
        local gen_coverage_result=$?
        if [ $gen_coverage_result -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Error: Gen coverage failed with exit code: $gen_coverage_result"
            exit $gen_coverage_result
        fi
    fi
  fi
}

function build_pkg_for_single_soc() {
    local single_soc_option="$1"
    local original_option="${CUSTOM_OPTION}"
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION}  -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=ON -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=OFF"
        cmake_config ${single_soc_option}
        build_package
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${original_option}"
    elif [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_IN" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION}  -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=ON -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=ON"
        cmake_config ${single_soc_option}
        build_package
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${original_option}"
    fi
}

function build_example_for_ci()
{
    EXAMPLE_NAME="$1"
    PKG_MODE="cust"

    EXAMPLE_MODE="eager"
    local eager_result=0
    build_example || eager_result=$? # 避免函数随build_example一起退出
    if [ $eager_result -ne 0 ] && [ $eager_result -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: Eager Example failed with exit code: $eager_result"
        exit $eager_result
    fi

    EXAMPLE_MODE="graph"
    local geir_result=0
    build_example || geir_result=$? # 避免函数随build_example一起退出
    if [ $geir_result -ne 0 ] && [ $geir_result -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: Graph Example failed with exit code: $geir_result"
        exit $geir_result
    fi

    if [ $eager_result -eq 2 ] && [ $geir_result -eq 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: Neither eager nor graph examples provided for $EXAMPLE_NAME"
        exit $geir_result
    fi
    return 0
}

# 冒烟任务只跑examples
function process_ci_smoke_with_changed_list()
{
    TEST=$(python3 "$CURRENT_DIR"/cmake/scripts/parse_changed_files.py -c "$CURRENT_DIR"/tests/test_config.yaml -f "$PR_CHANGED_FILES" get_related_examples)
    echo "Operators that need to run examples: $TEST"
    if [[ -z "$TEST" ]];then
        echo "No related unit tests found. Skipping CI test execution."
        exit 0
    fi
    IFS=';' read -ra OPS_ARRAY <<< "$TEST"
    for op in "${OPS_ARRAY[@]}";do
        op=$(echo "$op" | xargs)
        echo "Running example test for operator: $op"
        if [[ -n "$op" ]];then
            build_example_for_ci "$op"
        fi
    done
}
if [[ "$ENABLE_SMOKE" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    process_ci_smoke_with_changed_list
fi

cd ${BUILD_DIR}

if [[ "$ENABLE_RUN_EXAMPLE" == "TRUE" ]];then
    build_example
    example_result=$?
    if [ $example_result -eq 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: ${EXAMPLE_NAME} do not have ${EXAMPLE_MODE} example"
    elif [ $example_result -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "Example failed with exit code: $example_result"
    else
        echo "Example completed successfully"
    fi
    exit $example_result
fi


function build_pr_ut_mc2()
{
    echo "Operators mc2 that need to run UT: $TEST_MC2"
    if [ -z "${TEST_MC2}" ];then
            log "Info: This PR didn't trigger any mc2 UTest."
            return
    fi
    if [ "$TEST_MC2" != "all" ];then
            TEST_MC2="${TEST_MC2%;}"
            TEST_MC2="${TEST_MC2//;/,}"
            CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DASCEND_OP_NAME=${TEST_MC2}"
    fi
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DTESTS_UT_OPS_TEST_CI_PR=ON"
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DTESTS_UT_OPS_TEST=${TEST_MC2}"
    for element in "${UT_SOC_ARRAY[@]}"; do
            if [ $UT_TEST_CNT -eq 0 ]; then
                CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DUT_INFERSHAPE_FLAG=TRUE"
                CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_API_UT=TRUE"
            else
                CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DUT_INFERSHAPE_FLAG=FALSE"
                CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_API_UT=FALSE"
            fi
            echo "start to test $element"
            process_soc_input "$element"
            set_compute_unit_option_ut
            build_ut ${BUILD}
            UT_TEST_CNT=$((UT_TEST_CNT +1))
    done
}

function build_pr_ut_exclude_mc2()
{
    echo "Operators exclude mc2 that need to run UT: $TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2"
    if [ -z "${TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2}" ];then
            log "Info: This PR didn't trigger any exclude mc2 UTest."
            return
    fi
    if [ "$TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2" != "all" ];then
            TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2="${TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2%;}"
            TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2="${TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2//;/,}"
            CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DASCEND_OP_NAME=${TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2}"
    fi
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DTESTS_UT_OPS_TEST_CI_PR=ON"
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DTESTS_UT_OPS_TEST=${TEST_EXCLUDE_MC2}"
    process_soc_input "ascend310p,ascend910b,ascend950"
    set_compute_unit_option_ut
    build_ut ${BUILD}
}

main() {

if [[ "$ENABLE_GENOP" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    gen_op
fi
if [[ "$ENABLE_GENOP_AICPU" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    gen_aicpu_op
fi

if [[ "$ENABLE_TORCH_EXTENSION_ONLY" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    build_torch_extension_whl || exit 1
    mkdir -p "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}"
    cp "${CURRENT_DIR}/torch_extension/dist/"*.whl "${BUILD_OUT_DIR}/"
    log "[INFO] torch_extension whl package copied to ${BUILD_OUT_DIR}"
    exit 0
fi

if [[ "$ENABLE_TEST" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    if [[ "$PR_UT_FLAG" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        build_pr_ut_exclude_mc2
        build_pr_ut_mc2
    else
        set_compute_unit_option_ut
        build_ut ${BUILD}
    fi
    exit 0
elif [[ "$ENABLE_CREATE_LIB" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    build_lib
elif [[ "$ENABLE_STATIC" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    IFS=';' read -ra SOC_ARRAY <<< "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS"  # 分割字符串为数组
    for soc in "${SOC_ARRAY[@]}"; do
        soc=$(echo "${soc}" | xargs)  # 去除前后空格
        if [[ -n "${soc}" ]]; then  # 检查非空
            if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "FALSE" ]]; then
                cmake_config -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${soc}
                build_kernel
            fi
            build_static_lib ${soc}
            if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILD_PKG" == "TRUE" ]]; then
                package_static ${soc}
            fi
        fi
        make clean
    done
elif [[ "$ENABLE_OPKERNEL" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    set_compute_unit_option
    cmake_config -DENABLE_HOST_TILING=ON
    build_kernel
elif [[ "$ENABLE_AICPU_KERNEL" == "TRUE" && "$ENABLE_BUILD_PKG" != "TRUE" && "$ENABLE_BUILT_CUSTOM" != "TRUE" ]]; then
    set_compute_unit_option
    cmake_config -DENABLE_HOST_TILING=ON -DENABLE_AICPU_KERNEL=TRUE
    build_kernel
elif [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_CUSTOM" == "TRUE" ]]; then      # --ops, --vendor 新命令新使用
    set_compute_unit_option
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILT_JIT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        ops_kernel_value="OFF"
    else
        ops_kernel_value="ON"
    fi
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION}  -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=OFF -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=${ops_kernel_value}"
    if [[ "$ENABLE_BUILD_PKG" == "TRUE" ]]; then      # --pkg 新命令新使用
        cmake_config " -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON"
    else
        cmake_config " -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=OFF"
    fi
    build_package
elif [[ "$ENABLE_BUILD_PKG" == "TRUE" ]]; then      # --pkg 新命令新使用
    # 构建 torch_extension whl 包
    build_torch_extension_whl || exit 1
    IFS=';' read -ra SOC_ARRAY <<< "$ASCEND_SOC_UNITS"  # 分割字符串为数组
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON"
    for soc in "${SOC_ARRAY[@]}"; do
        soc=$(echo "${soc}" | xargs)  # 去除前后空格
        soc_options=" -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${soc}"
        if [[ -n "${soc}" ]]; then  # 检查非空
            build_pkg_for_single_soc ${soc_options} && make clean
        fi
    done
else
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON"
    if [ "${BUILD}" == "host" ];then
        cmake_config -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=OFF -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON
        build_host
        # TO DO
        rm -rf ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
        mkdir -p ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
        cp ${BUILD_DIR}/*.run ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
    elif [ "${BUILD}" == "kernel" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=OFF -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=ON -DBUILD_OPS_RTY_KERNEL=ON"
        cmake_config
        build_kernel
    elif [ "${BUILD}" == "package" ];then
        # 构建 torch_extension whl 包
        build_torch_extension_whl || exit 1
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION}  -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=ON -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=ON"
        build_package
    elif [ -n "${BUILD}" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION}  -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=ON"
        cmake_config
        build ${BUILD}
    fi
fi
}

main
} | while IFS= read -r line; do echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $line"; done

input.rationale: ops-transformer 是 CANN 生态中面向 transformer 大模型的进阶算子库，代码规模大（attention/moe/mc2/ffn/gmm/mamba/mhc/posembedding 等数百个算子），但每个算子都遵循统一的「op_host + op_api/op_graph + op_kernel + tests + examples」目录范式，因此学习路线设计为：先用入门单元建立项目定位、环境部署、构建体系和目录范式的整体认知；再以仓库自带的 add_example 教学算子为最小样本，逐层拆解 host 侧定义/tiling/infershape、device 侧 kernel 与 eager/graph 两种调用方式；随后进入 intermediate 层，讲清 aclnn 两阶段 API、common 公共库、torch_extension PyTorch 接入和精度测试体系；在此基础上按模块精读 attention（FA 家族、推理量化、稀疏与 indexer）、moe/ffn/mc2 三大业务域的代表性算子，理解真实大模型算子的 tiling 策略、多 SoC 架构适配与通信融合；最后在 advanced 层覆盖从零开发算子（genop 脚手架 + 开发指南）、ONNX 插件、调试调优、experimental 扩展模板、UT/CI 工程化与贡献流程，形成「会用 → 会读 → 会写 → 会贡献」的完整闭环。单元间依赖递进，讲义只引用真实存在的源码文件，每篇配一个可操作的代码实践任务。

units.title: 测试、工程化与社区贡献

data.head: b2adacfe384b910c6965ca19236e42152674a87c
data.rationale: ops-transformer 是 CANN 生态中面向 transformer 大模型的进阶算子库，代码规模大（attention/moe/mc2/ffn/gmm/mamba/mhc/posembedding 等数百个算子），但每个算子都遵循统一的「op_host + op_api/op_graph + op_kernel + tests + examples」目录范式，因此学习路线设计为：先用入门单元建立项目定位、环境部署、构建体系和目录范式的整体认知；再以仓库自带的 add_example 教学算子为最小样本，逐层拆解 host 侧定义/tiling/infershape、device 侧 kernel 与 eager/graph 两种调用方式；随后进入 intermediate 层，讲清 aclnn 两阶段 API、common 公共库、torch_extension PyTorch 接入和精度测试体系；在此基础上按模块精读 attention（FA 家族、推理量化、稀疏与 indexer）、moe/ffn/mc2 三大业务域的代表性算子，理解真实大模型算子的 tiling 策略、多 SoC 架构适配与通信融合；最后在 advanced 层覆盖从零开发算子（genop 脚手架 + 开发指南）、ONNX 插件、调试调优、experimental 扩展模板、UT/CI 工程化与贡献流程，形成「会用 → 会读 → 会写 → 会贡献」的完整闭环。单元间依赖递进，讲义只引用真实存在的源码文件，每篇配一个可操作的代码实践任务。

lectures.practice_task: 阅读 add_example_def.cpp 中 DoInferShape 的逻辑，为本算子新增一个输出 shape 规则（例如输出第二个与输入同 shape 的 tensor），修改后重新编译 --ophost 并跑通其 UT 观察变化。
lectures.title: op_host 三件套：def、infershape 与 tiling
lectures.topic: 精读宿主侧三个关键文件：算子原型定义（def）、shape 推导（infershape）和 tiling 切分策略计算，理解 host 侧如何为 device 侧准备元数据。

learning_goals: 读懂一个最小 AscendC kernel 的入口与计算流程
理解 tiling key 与 tiling data 如何在 host/device 间传递
掌握 GM 内存与 Local 内存的基本使用模式
lectures.practice_task: 把 add_example 的 kernel 从「逐元素相加」改造成「逐元素相加后乘以 2」，同步确认 tiling 与 host 侧是否需要修改；编译 --opkernel 后用 tests/ut/op_kernel 的数据生成脚本（gen_data.py/compare_data.py）验证结果正确。
lectures.title: op_kernel：第一个 AscendC 设备核函数
lectures.topic: 精读 device 侧 AscendC 核函数源码，理解 kernel 入口、tiling data 结构、tiling key 宏以及 GM 与 Local 内存上的数据搬运和 Vector 计算。

learning_goals: 掌握 aclnn Eager 模式的 GetWorkspaceSize/Run 两段式调用写法
掌握 GE 图模式下算子的构图与执行方式
会用 build.sh --run_example 一键编译执行示例
lectures.practice_task: 在 NPU 或 simulator 环境运行 bash build.sh --run_example add_example eager 与 graph 两种模式；然后仿照 test_aclnn_add_example.cpp 写一个最小程序，把输入换成自己构造的两个 1x8 fp16 向量并打印输出。
lectures.title: 运行算子示例：Eager 与 Graph 两种方式
lectures.topic: 学习通过 build.sh --run_example 分别以 eager（aclnn 直调）和 graph（GE 图执行）方式编译运行算子示例，并读懂两种示例代码的调用骨架。

learning_goals: 理解 AICore 与 AICPU 算子的适用场景差异
读懂 AICPU 算子的 json 定义与实现结构
会用 --genop_aicpu 与 --opkernel_aicpu 构建教学算子
lectures.practice_task: 运行 bash build.sh --genop_aicpu=examples/my_first_aicpu 生成一个 AICPU 算子骨架，对比它与 add_example/op_kernel_aicpu 的差异，然后按 aicpu_develop_guide.md 尝试实现一个「输出等于输入减 1」的算子并编译。
lectures.title: AICPU 算子初探
lectures.topic: 了解 AICPU 算子与 AICore 算子的区别、add_example 的 AICPU 实现结构，以及如何用 --genop_aicpu 和 --opkernel_aicpu 构建调试。

units.title: 第一个算子：add_example 由内到外

learning_goals: 理解两阶段 API 的设计动机与 workspace 机制
掌握常见 aclnn 返回码的含义与排查方法
理解非连续 tensor、广播、数据格式对算子调用的影响
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 two_phase_api.md 与 aclnn_return_code.md，选取 aclnn_flash_attention_score 的调用示例，手工拆出 GetWorkspaceSize 与 Run 两步的参数含义；再构造一个非连续输入（转置后的 tensor）调用算子，观察并解释报错或行为差异。
lectures.title: aclnn 两阶段 API 与基础概念
lectures.topic: 系统讲解 aclnn 两阶段接口（GetWorkspaceSize + Run）的设计、workspace 机制、数据类型与格式约定、非连续 tensor 处理和返回码体系。

learning_goals: 了解 common 库的分层结构与各 include 目录职责
理解 fallback 机制在通信类算子中的作用
学会在新算子中正确复用 common 头文件与工具
lectures.practice_task: 浏览 common/include 下各子目录，挑选 3 个可复用的工具（如错误码、shape 工具、tiling 辅助），在自己 u2 的改造版 add_example host 代码中引入其中一个并保持编译通过，写一段使用说明。
lectures.title: common 公共库与 fallback 机制
lectures.topic: 介绍 common 目录提供的公共头文件与实现：host/kernel/api/graph 各层公共工具、错误处理、tiling_sink 以及 mc2 通信 fallback 实现，理解大型算子库的代码复用方式。

learning_goals: 理解 torch_extension 包把 aclnn 算子包装为 PyTorch API 的方式
掌握 op_builder 与 ops 注册的组织结构
会用 --torch_extension_only 单独构建 whl 并在 PyTorch 中调用
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 torch_extension/cann_ops_transformer/ops.py 与 op_builder 目录，梳理「Python 前端函数 -> aclnn 调用」的映射链路；然后执行 bash build.sh --pkg --torch_extension_only 构建 whl（或在无 NPU 环境下走读 setup.py），写一段伪调用代码演示如何在 torch 模型中使用其中任一算子。
lectures.title: torch_extension：PyTorch 侧接入算子
lectures.topic: 讲解 torch_extension 包如何把 aclnn 算子封装成 PyTorch 友好接口，包括 ops 模块组织、op_builder 构建逻辑以及 whl 打包方式。

learning_goals: 掌握 pytest 精度测试用例的组织与运行方式
学会用 numpy/torch 构造参考实现与 rtol/atol 判定
理解不同数据类型下的精度验收标准差异
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 flash_attention_score 的 pytest README 与任一测试文件，为本算子补充一个自定义 shape 的 pytest 用例（如 batch=1、heads=2 的短序列场景），在 NPU 或 simulator 上运行并记录精度指标。
lectures.title: 精度验证与 pytest 测试实践
lectures.topic: 介绍算子精度验证的方法论：pytest 用例组织、gen_data/compare_data 数据构造与比对脚本、以及 ut/st 两类测试的关系。

learning_goals: 梳理 FA 算子家族各版本的演进脉络与适用场景
理解 FA 设计文档中的分块计算与 softmax 在线修正思想
定位 FA 算子各版本源码与接口文档
lectures.practice_task: 对照 aclnnFlashAttentionScore.md 系列接口文档，整理一张版本对照表（V2/V3/V4 的关键新增参数与支持的 SoC），并用一篇 300 字小结说明训练（Score/Grad）与推理（Incre/FusedInfer）两条产品线的分工。
lectures.title: Flash Attention 算子家族概览
lectures.topic: 纵览 flash_attention_score 及其衍生（grad、incre、varlen、quant 等）算子家族，理解训练与推理场景下 attention 计算的算法分块思想与版本演进。

learning_goals: 读懂一个工业级 aclnn 接口文件的完整结构
理解参数校验、dtype/layout 约束与错误码抛出的写法
掌握多版本接口共用 base 实现的组织方式
lectures.practice_task: 在 aclnn_flash_attention_score.cpp 中追踪一个参数（如 scale_value）从入口到 inner 实现的完整路径，画出调用链；然后仿照其校验风格，为 u2 改造的算子补充输入 dtype 校验与对应错误码。
lectures.title: FA 算子 op_api 层源码精读
lectures.topic: 精读 aclnn_flash_attention_score.cpp 的接口实现：参数校验、输入约束、workspace 计算、两阶段调用分发以及头文件中的接口声明约定。

learning_goals: 理解复杂算子 tiling 策略与硬件资源约束的关系
掌握 arch22/arch35 多架构目录的组织与编译裁剪方式
读懂 tiling_common 等共享头文件的抽象手段
lectures.practice_task: 对比 flash_attention_score 的 arch22 与 arch35 两个目录的文件构成与 tiling 差异（可用 --soc=ascend910b 与 --soc=ascend950 分别编译），总结一份「新增一个 SoC 架构需要交付哪些文件」的 checklist。
lectures.title: FA 的 tiling 策略与多 SoC 架构适配
lectures.topic: 分析 FA 算子 host 侧 tiling 如何结合 UB/内存约束选择分块，以及 op_host/op_kernel 下 arch22、arch35 目录如何隔离不同代际硬件的实现。

learning_goals: 理解 KV Cache 场景下推理 attention 算子的输入布局
理解多版本共存的 base/inner 代码组织与版本演进策略
了解 checkers、tiling_info 等工程化拆分手段
lectures.practice_task: 对比 aclnnFusedInferAttentionScore.md 与 aclnnFusedInferAttentionScoreV5.md 的接口差异，整理 KV Cache 相关参数（如 blockTable、kvPaddingSize 等）的含义表；然后在 fused_infer_attention_score_base_aclnn.cpp 中定位这些参数的校验逻辑并摘录关键代码。
lectures.title: fused_infer_attention_score：推理场景与版本演进
lectures.topic: 以 fused_infer_attention_score 为例，学习 KV Cache 推理 attention 的接口设计、V2~V5 的版本演进方式以及 base/inner 分层复用大量公共逻辑的工程手法。

learning_goals: 理解量化模式（per-tensor/per-axis/MxFP8 等）对算子接口设计的影响
理解 sparse_mode 的语义与稀疏 attention 的收益
理解 lightning_indexer 等 TopK 筛选算子在稀疏训练中的位置
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 quant_mode_introduction.md 与 sparse_mode_introduction.md 后，在 quant_flash_attn 的 tiling/def 源码中找出量化相关分支（如 qfa_tiling_shape.cpp 对量化 shape 的处理），画出一幅「全量化 dense attention + TopK 稀疏」的数据流示意图，标注每一步使用的算子。
lectures.title: 量化与稀疏：quant attention 与 lightning indexer
lectures.topic: 讲解 quant_flash_attn 等全量化 attention 算子与 lightning_indexer 系列 TopK 筛选算子的配合关系，覆盖量化模式与稀疏模式两大概念文档。

learning_goals: 梳理 MoE 一轮前向中各算子的调用顺序与张量流转
理解图模式算子与 aclnn 算子在调用方式上的差异
读懂 routing 类算子的 tiling 与 shape 定义
lectures.practice_task: 以 moe_token_permute 与 moe_init_routing 为对象，列出各自 op_host 中 def 文件定义的输入输出张量，并画出「gating -> init_routing -> token_permute -> (expert 计算) -> token_unpermute」的流程图，标注每步输入输出的 shape 来源。
lectures.title: MoE 模块：路由与 token 重排算子链路
lectures.topic: 以 moe_init_routing、moe_token_permute/unpermute 为例，理解 MoE 前向中路由、重排、恢复整条算子链路，以及这类无 op_api 图模式算子的组织方式。

learning_goals: 理解 ffn 算子将多层计算融合进单个 kernel 的动机
读懂 swin 系列变体算子的场景差异
对比 ffn 与 attention 算子在目录范式上的异同
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 ffn/ffn 的 README 与 def/tiling 源码，写一段分析：该算子融合了哪些子计算、为什么融合后能减少 kernel 启动与访存开销；再浏览 swin_attention_ffn 目录，说明它与基础 ffn 的输入差异。
lectures.title: FFN 模块与 swin 变体算子
lectures.topic: 了解 ffn 主算子与 swin_transformer_ln_qkv、ffn_worker_scheduler 等变体的融合设计，理解算子域内「主算子 + 场景变体」的组织方式。

learning_goals: 理解通信-计算融合算子的收益模型
掌握 matmul_all_reduce 的版本组织与 util 复用方式
了解 mc2/common 提供的公共能力
lectures.practice_task: 在 matmul_all_reduce_util.cpp 中找出通信与矩阵乘的衔接逻辑（如切分策略、通信域处理），总结 V2/V3/quant/weight_quant 各版本差异；然后在 examples/mc2 下任选一个示例走读其编译依赖（-lhccl 等），说明 mc2 示例与普通 aclnn 示例构建上的区别。
lectures.title: mc2 模块：通信计算融合算子
lectures.topic: 以 matmul_all_reduce 与 all_gather_matmul 为例，理解「矩阵乘 + 集合通信」融合算子的设计、多版本组织与 mc2/common 公共库的支撑。

learning_goals: 理解 EP 场景下 dispatch/combine 的 setup/run/teardown 生命周期
理解 barrier 类算子在多卡同步中的作用
能拼出一条完整的分布式 MoE 前向调用序列
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 moe_distribute_dispatch 与 moe_distribute_dispatch_setup/teardown 的 README，写出一次两卡 EP MoE 前向需要的算子调用顺序（含 setup/teardown 与 barrier）；说明 v2/v3 版本并存的原因（可结合 build.sh 中对 dispatch/combine v2 自动补编 v3 的逻辑佐证）。
lectures.title: mc2 分布式 MoE：dispatch/combine 与同步原语
lectures.topic: 讲解 moe_distribute_dispatch/combine 及其 setup/teardown、distribute_barrier 等分布式 MoE 通信算子族，理解专家并行（EP）场景的算子协作。

learning_goals: 掌握从建目录到编译运行的自定义 AICore 算子全流程
理解 opgen 脚手架生成物与最小交付件清单
了解从 Ascend/samples 仓迁移算子的路径
lectures.practice_task: 执行 bash build.sh --genop=examples/my_sum 生成算子骨架，按 aicore_develop_guide.md 实现一个「沿最后一维求和」的算子：完成 def/infershape/tiling/kernel 与一个 eager 示例，编译通过后用 --run_example 验证正确性。
lectures.title: 从零开发一个 AICore 算子
lectures.topic: 结合算子开发指南与 --genop 脚手架，走完自定义 AICore 算子的最小交付件：目录生成、host 三件套、kernel、配置与示例。

learning_goals: 理解 GE 图模式下算子原型与 graph infer 的职责
读懂 fusion_pass 的注册与匹配逻辑
区分 op_graph 层与 op_host/op_api 层的边界
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 add_example 的 op_graph 三个文件与 graph_develop_guide.md，说明 proto 声明与 graph_infer 各自的作用；然后观察 flash_attention_score/op_graph 目录结构，写一段「一个算子同时支持 eager 与 graph 两种交付」需要额外维护哪些内容的总结。
lectures.title: op_graph 与图融合入门
lectures.topic: 讲解 op_graph 目录承载的算子图信息推导与 fusion_pass 融合能力，以 add_example 的 proto/graph_infer 为最小样本。

learning_goals: 理解 onnx plugin 把 ONNX 模型算子映射到 NPU 算子的机制
读懂一个 onnx 插件的解析与调用实现
掌握 NPUFlashAttention/NPUMultiHeadAttention 等插件的适用场景
lectures.practice_task: 对照 multi_head_attention_onnx_plugin.cpp 与 flash_attention_score/framework 目录，梳理插件从 ONNX 节点属性到 aclnn 参数的映射规则；选择其中一个插件，写出它支持的 ONNX 输入约束与落到 NPU 算子的对应关系表。
lectures.title: ONNX 插件框架：让 ONNX 模型跑上 NPU 算子
lectures.topic: 介绍 transformer 类 onnx 算子插件机制：NPUFlashAttention、NPUMultiHeadAttention 等插件如何解析 ONNX 图并把计算落到本项目算子上。

learning_goals: 掌握 profiler 定位算子耗时的基本方法
掌握 NPU Simulator 仿真开发调试流程
了解 --dump_cce、--oom、--mssanitizer 等构建级调试开关的使用场景
lectures.practice_task: 在 simulator 模式下用 build.sh --run_example add_example eager --simulator=camodel --soc=ascend950 跑通一次仿真（无 NPU 环境则走读文档写出步骤）；再用 --dump_cce 重新编译算子，找到 dump 出的 CCE 中间文件并说明它能帮助分析什么问题。
lectures.title: 调试与调优：prof 与 NPU Simulator
lectures.topic: 学习算子级调试调优手段：profiler 性能分析、NPU Simulator 仿真运行，以及 --dump_cce/--oom/--mssanitizer 等构建调试开关。

learning_goals: 理解 experimental 目录与正式算子目录的发布差异
掌握 NpuOpsTransformerExt 模板中 Python 前端与 C++ 实现的绑定方式
会用模板快速起一个支持自动微分的自定义算子工程
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 experimental/npu_ops_transformer_ext 的 setup.py、ops.py 与 npu_ops_def.cpp，画出「Python 调用 -> C++ 扩展 -> NPU kernel」的层次图；然后在该模板中新增一个 my_add 函数（CPU 参考实现 + NPU 路径骨架），跑通 import 与调用（无 NPU 时验证 CPU fallback 分支）。
lectures.title: experimental 目录与算子工程模板
lectures.topic: 介绍 experimental 实验目录的定位，以及 NpuOpsTransformerExt 工程模板：无缝集成 PyTorch 张量操作、自动微分与 GPU/NPU 统一接口的二次开发范式。

units.title: 算子开发、调试与扩展（专家之路）

learning_goals: 掌握 ophost/opapi/opgraph/opkernel 四类 UT 的写法与运行方式
理解 UT 框架新旧版本与 test_config.yaml 的配置关系
能为自定义算子补齐最小 UT 集
lectures.practice_task: 为 u6 开发的 my_sum 算子仿照 add_example/tests 补齐 ophost UT（tiling 与 infershape 各一个用例），用 bash build.sh --ophost_test --ops=my_sum --noexec 验证可编译；再解释 test_config.yaml 在大规模测试裁剪中的作用。
lectures.title: 单元测试体系与 UT 框架
lectures.topic: 系统讲解 ophost/opapi/opgraph/opkernel 四类单元测试的组织、用例写法、tiling UT 数据构造，以及 --ophost_test/--opapi_test 等运行入口。

learning_goals: 理解 PR 级 UT/example 按变更文件裁剪执行的机制
理解 classify_rule.yaml 与 test_config.yaml 的分工
了解版本号管理与 run/rpm/deb 出包流程
lectures.practice_task: 走读 build.sh 中 --PR_UT/--PR_PKG 分支与 scripts/ci 目录，画出一幅「提交 PR -> 解析变更算子 -> 按需 UT/出包」的流程图；再用 --pkg-type=deb 的帮助信息说明三种包类型的差异与适用场景。
lectures.title: CI 流水线与版本发布机制
lectures.topic: 分析仓库的 CI 工程化：changed files 解析、按算子裁剪 UT 与出包、SoC 矩阵、以及 run/rpm/deb 包类型与版本管理。

learning_goals: 掌握一次合格算子贡献需要交付的全部文件清单
理解 fork-branch-PR 的协作流程与门禁检查
了解 OAT 开源合规检查的内容
lectures.practice_task: 以 u6/u7 已完成的 my_sum 算子为基础，对照 aicore_develop_guide 的最小交付件与 CONTRIBUTING.md 的流程，模拟发起一次贡献：整理目录、补齐 README 与文档、写 PR 描述，并运行仓库的 pre-commit/OAT 检查脚本验证通过。
lectures.title: 贡献流程与代码规范
lectures.topic: 讲解向社区贡献算子的完整流程：目录与交付件规范、commit 信息、pre-commit 检查、PR 模板与 review 要求。

learning_goals: 能从架构图出发解释各层库的依赖关系
能归纳 tiling、多 SoC、多版本演进三大横切机制的设计模式
形成对算子库可维护性与扩展性权衡的独立判断
lectures.practice_task: 撰写一篇学习总结：结合本手册覆盖的 3 个代表算子（flash_attention_score、matmul_all_reduce、moe_token_permute），归纳本仓库「同域算子家族 + 版本演进 + 架构隔离」三种复用手段的优劣，并提出 2 条你认为可以改进的方向（附源码证据）。
lectures.title: 架构复盘与学习路线总结
